description: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) measures the change in the price of goods and services from the perspective of the consumer. It is a key way to measure changes in purchasing trends and <a title="" href="https://www.investing.com/academy/trading/inflation-definition/">inflation</a>.<BR/><BR/>A higher than expected reading should be taken as positive/bullish for the USD, while a lower than expected reading should be taken as negative/bearish for the USD.
